name: rosetta-convert-seconds-to-compound-duration
code:
use default

let units = [
    (suffix = "wk", size = 604800),
    (suffix = "d", size = 86400),
    (suffix = "hr", size = 3600),
    (suffix = "min", size = 60),
    (suffix = "sec", size = 1)
]

parts(total: int) -> Ghul.Pipes.Pipe[string] is
    let remaining mut = total

    for unit in units do
        let count = remaining / unit.size
        remaining = remaining % unit.size

        if count > 0 then
            yield "{count} {unit.suffix}"
        fi
    od
si

compound_duration(total: int) -> string => parts(total) |> join(", ")

for seconds in [7259, 86400, 6000000] do
    write_line("{seconds}: {compound_duration(seconds)}")
od
